title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by the statutes of 1981, Chapter 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of an interim changes in the fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of March, April, and May, 1985. Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's oil conservation adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of March, April and May, 1985.
